ai_summary: **Executive Summary: AGI Greenpac Limited Dividend TDS Policy**  AGI Greenpac Limited's recommended FY2025-26 dividend of Rs. 7 will now be subject to Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) under amended Income Tax Act provisions, impacting shareholders' net payouts. To avoid higher TDS rates (up to 30% for non-compliance or specific non-residents) or dividend withholding (for physical shares without updated KYC), all shareholders must submit relevant tax exemption or lower-rate documents online by September 15, 2026, even if previously provided. This creates a significant administrative burden and a tight deadline, with non-residents facing additional complexities and company discretion for DTAA benefit approval.
